badge.animated_armor.armor_break.tooltip: For each 25% of durability you lose, a piece of your armor will break. Armor will always break in this order: Head, Chest, Legs, Feet.
badge.animated_armor.crippled.tooltip: Losing your Leggings gives you a boost in movement speed.
badge.animated_armor.nearsighted.tooltip: Losing your Helmet will only render entities close to you.
badge.animated_armor.repair.tooltip: Active ability, use with %s while holding a Iron Ingot in your hands.
badge.animated_armor.weakened.tooltip: Losing your Chestplate will greatly reduce your reach and damage.
origin.animated_armor.animated_armor.des: A sentient suit of magically animated armor, brought to life by unknown arcane enchantments.
power.animated_armor.construct.descripti: Your body doesn't experience hunger, and you don't benefit from natural regeneration.
power.animated_armor.construct.name: Construct
power.animated_armor.decoy.description: Become an immobile suit of armor. Mobs will not target you in this state.
power.animated_armor.decoy.name: Decoy
You take no damage from regular arrows while your armor is fully intact.
power.animated_armor.fixed_armor.descrip: You inhabit a suit of armor. You cannot equip other armors or remove your armor.
power.animated_armor.fixed_armor.name: Living Armor
power.animated_armor.freeze_immune.descr: You are immune to freeze damage.
power.animated_armor.freeze_immune.name: Frost Ward
power.animated_armor.immune.description: You are immune to all potion and status effects.
power.animated_armor.immune.name: Antimagic Ward
power.animated_armor.no_shields.descript: Your form is too rigid to use a shield effectively.
power.animated_armor.no_shields.name: Immobile Joints
power.animated_armor.prevent_food.name: No Stomach
power.animated_armor.repair.description: Your body cannot be naturally or magically mended. You instead repair by consuming Iron Ingots.
power.animated_armor.repair.name: Metallurgy
power.animated_armor.restless.name: Restless
power.animated_armor.sink.description: Your dense body weighs you down in water, but also renders you immune to knockback. You don't need to breathe in water as you have no lungs.
power.animated_armor.sink.name: Heavy Metal
power.animated_armor.slow.description: Your lack of limbs causes you to move 20% slower than a human. However, you have greater effective reach while your chestplate is intact.
power.animated_armor.slow.name: Disembodied
You do not take health damage. Instead, you have a meter that displays the overall durability of your armour, which can only take one point of damage per attack.
